# Margarita Cuesta

> Margarita Cuesta is a bilingual (English and Spanish) real estate broker and REALTOR® serving Raleigh, Durham and the Triangle. She helps buyers, sellers, landlords and investors, with her license held through The Insight Group as a member of the Corrales Real Estate Team.

- Role: Real Estate Broker, REALTOR®

- Languages: English and Spanish
- Areas served: Raleigh, Durham, Cary, Apex, Knightdale, Wake County, the Research Triangle
- Services: buying, selling, renting out a property (tenant placement), investing

## About, in her words
I’m a REALTOR® serving the Raleigh, Durham, and Triangle area, known for a structured approach, strong negotiation skills, and precise, professional representation. Fluent in English and Spanish, I work with homeowners, buyers, and investors who value clear communication and a process that stays organized from the first conversation through closing.

I bring strategy, careful analysis, and close attention to detail to every transaction, coordinating with lenders, attorneys, and inspectors so my clients always have accurate, timely information to act on.

As part of a team dedicated to helping families build generational wealth, I bring the experience and consistency needed to move each deal forward with confidence. Above all, I believe my clients deserve straight answers, steady guidance, and a process where nothing is left to chance.
